package.name: rh56dftp_description
package.description: ament wrapper exposing the framework-agnostic ../../rh56dftp_description package (URDF/xacro/meshes/tactile layout of the Inspire Hand RH56DFTP) to ROS 2. It installs the sibling directory content verbatim under share/rh56dftp_description so that the existing xacro references ($(find rh56dftp_description), package://rh56dftp_description/meshes/...) resolve. The wrapped package itself is intentionally NOT an ament package (it is consumed ROS-free by Pinocchio/MuJoCo in h1v2-imitation) and must not be modified — this wrapper only re-publishes it.
